item.title: Bomb scare on Kolkata -Shillong IndiGo flight, aircraft moved to isolation bay
item.description: A bomb threat was received on an IndiGo flight from Kolkata to Shillong on Saturday morning. As passengers were boarding the aircraft, the crew found a piece of paper inside the washroom of the plane, which said that a bomb had been placed inside the aircraft. Immediately all passengers were deboarded and the plane was moved to an isolated area for checking.

item.title: Indian student goes missing in California; backpack with passport and laptop found near university campus
item.description: An Indian student studying at UC Berkeley has been missing since February 9. An alumnus of Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras), Saketh Sreenivasaiah’s passport and laptop were found in a bag near the university campus.

item.title: Prashant Narayanan slams Kartik Aaryan: ‘One of the most terrible actors we have’
item.description: Prashant Narayanan slammed Kartik Aaryan as “one of the most terrible actors we have,” surviving only on “parents’ blessings.” He noted fans laugh at his films, not with him, despite hits like Bhool Bhulaiyaa.

item.title: Valentine’s Day 2026 in Pune: Top exciting events, candlelight dinners and unique celebration ideas
item.description: Valentine’s Day 2026 in Pune brings creative workshops, live music, candlelight dinners and fun experiences. Here are the top places to celebrate love across the city.

item.title: Trusted Tech Alliance launched: Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud Among 15 global giants unite
item.description: Fifteen major technology companies from 10 countries have launched the Trusted Tech Alliance at the Munich Security Conference. The coalition aims to strengthen transparency, security, data protection, and supply chain resilience across AI, cloud, connectivity, and semiconductor technologies.

item.title: Stepping away from glitz, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi set to appear for CBSE class 10 board exams
item.description: Rising Indian star Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is set to appear in his class 10th board exams after his pivotal performance that guided India to the Under-19 World Cup glory.

item.title: From pharma to power, SEBI approves 5 IPOs: Know the details of each
item.description: Though 2026 is expected to be a record-setting year that is supposed eclipse the frenetic activity in the primary market in 2025, the current year has not seen much IPO activity. In fact, only a couple of IPOs have hit the market since the Union Budget 2026 on Feb 1.

item.title: Kannada cinema in mourning: Veteran director Joe Simon passes away suddenly
item.description: Veteran Kannada director Joe Simon, 80, died of a heart attack at a KFCC meeting in Bengaluru on Friday. Known for films like Sahasa Simha, he collapsed after suggesting celebrations. Deputy CM D K Shivakumar called it an irreparable loss to Kannada cinema. Tributes pour in for the industry pioneer.

item.title: PM Modi to inaugurate Rs 3,000 crore bridge over Brahmaputra: Key features
item.description: The bridge has been built as a six-lane corridor to handle heavy daily traffic, freight movement and long-distance vehicles.

item.title: In historic first, PM Narendra Modi lands at Dibrugarh’s Emergency Landing Facility
item.description: PM Narendra Modi on Saturday landed at the Emergency Landing Facility of the IAF, built in Dibrugarh, Assam. This is the first ELF of the northeast and the PM has inaugurated it on Saturday. This facility has been built at a cost of Rs 100 crore and will serve both military and civil needs in case of emergencies.
